name: Daljinsko Zaznavanje (Multi-Sensor EO)
updateContentCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gdal-bin libgdal-dev libgeos-dev libproj-dev fonts-dejavu-core && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip && python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
postAttachCommand: pgrep -f 'streamlit run app.py' >/dev/null || streamlit run app.py --server.port 8501 --server.address 0.0.0.0 --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
